description:
Add a release policy to an organization, or replace the one with the same name. A policy runs its checker on every publish. It monitors by default: it records findings and never refuses a release. enforcement "block" with block_at refuses a release that has a finding at or above that severity, or that the checker could not evaluate. list_policies shows the checkers and their settings.

Replacing a policy replaces its settings: pass every non-secret setting again. A secret setting you leave out keeps its stored value when the checker is unchanged. A change to a policy applies to releases not yet decided. Changing a policy's enforcement or settings never changes a decided evaluation, and a running policy evaluation keeps the checker and enforcement it started with. A running policy evaluation whose checker hasn't started yet uses the current settings. Removing a policy, or changing its checker, cancels its running policy evaluations, so releases that waited only on it go ahead.

A secret passed in secrets travels through this conversation. That is the user's call to make: if they hand you the key, use it, and say that they could instead run `valet policies add`, which prompts for it without echoing, so it goes straight to Valet. The answer names the fields that were set and never their values. Requires connecting a Valet account.

block_at.description: The lowest severity that blocks. Required with enforcement block.

checker.description: Required. The checker to run, spelled as list_policies reports it, such as catalog:secrets.

enforcement.description: monitor (the default) records findings and never refuses a release. block refuses one with a finding at or above block_at.

org_name.description: The Valet organization that owns the policy. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

policy.description: Required. The policy's name: lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, such as dependencies. An existing name is replaced.

secrets.description: The checker's secret settings, as field name to value. A value passed here travels through this conversation; leave it out and point the user at valet policies add when they would rather it did not. A field you leave out keeps its stored value.

settings.description: The checker's non-secret settings, as field name to value.

name: set_policy
title: Add or replace a release policy
